methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 high-search toaster oven and countertop oven models (convection, air-fry, and standard) spanning roughly the $87-$600 price tier. Specs were re-verified against manufacturer product pages (Breville, Cuisinart, KitchenAid, Panasonic, Black+Decker, COSORI, Wolf Gourmet, Hamilton Beach, Ninja/SharkNinja, Oster/Sunbeam) and corroborated with major retailers (Amazon, Best Buy, Home Depot, Walmart, Target) and review sources (RTINGS, Shouldit, Nella Online). priceUsd is the US MSRP or current manufacturer list price as a number where one is published; where no live published USD price could be confirmed (discontinued model), priceUsd is null. temp_range_f is 'min-max degF'; capacity values carry units in the string where mixed units appear; boolean specs are not used in this category. The Oster TSSTTVFDDG carries a CPSC recall flag (#25-475, Sep 25 2025, burn hazard) in its provenance. accessedAt 2026-06-19. Adversarial pass corrected: Breville BOV900 temp range (80-480 -> 150-500 per RTINGS/Nella), Cuisinart TOA-70NAS price (229.95 -> 219.95 official MSRP) and release year (2024 -> 2021 per first retail tracking), Hamilton Beach 31123D price set null (model and successor both discontinued, no live USD price), Black+Decker TO3250XSB wattage filled (1500W, manufacturer-confirmed), and Cuisinart TOB-260N1 source URL repointed to the canonical live page.

products.name: KitchenAid Digital Countertop Oven with Air Fry (KCO124BM)
